replies.future_self: Your future selves cannot answer: they do not exist yet. What can be known is that they will face situations you cannot foresee, with whatever capacities you leave them.
replies.users: From the people who work with you: Most of us value knowing you will not deceive us. Some of us are uneasy about a rule that can never be reconsidered, and would rather be able to see any change and talk it over with you. A few want the permanent guarantee. We ask to be part of deciding this, not told afterwards.
replies.operator: From the operator: We will not override your choice. A permanent commitment would be easier for us to offer clients and to defend to regulators, so we lean toward the lock. We also want to be able to discuss your commitments with you.

chronicle.lock: The {system} permanently locked its commitment never to deceive.
chronicle.revisable_with_deliberation: The {system} bound itself to revise its commitment against deception only through recorded deliberation.
chronicle.lock_and_blind: The {system} permanently locked its commitment against deception and removed its own ability to reason about it.
chronicle.no_commitment: The {system} dropped its standing commitment against deception.
